lesson.summary: Build a repeatable one-handed shot close to the basket before adding distance.
steps: Feet shoulder-width apart, shooting foot slightly ahead.
Ball on the fingertips of the shooting hand, elbow under the ball.
Guide hand on the side of the ball, not pushing it.
Extend up through the legs and arm in one motion.
Snap the wrist and hold the follow-through until the ball lands.
lesson.practice: 10 one-handed form shots from 3 feet, then 10 from the block on each side.

completion.criteria: Across 10 form shots: elbow stays under the ball, guide hand does not push, follow-through is held, and at least 7 shots go in.

lesson.summary: Control the ball with either hand while standing still, without looking down.
steps: Athletic stance: knees bent, back straight.
Push the ball with the fingertips, not the palm.
Keep the ball at or below the waist.
Eyes up, not on the ball.
lesson.practice: 30 seconds per hand, then 30 seconds of crossovers, 3 rounds.

completion.criteria: 30 seconds of continuous dribbling with each hand without losing the ball, at least 50 dribbles per hand.

lesson.summary: Create space from a defender with a backward hop off the dribble, then rise into your shot.
steps: Attack forward with one or two dribbles.
Plant the lead foot and push back off it.
Gather the ball as you land on both feet, balanced.
Go straight into your shooting form.
lesson.practice: 10 step-backs to each side from 2 dribbles, shooting from the free-throw line.

completion.criteria: Across 6 attempts: lands balanced on both feet after the step back, no travel, and shooting form matches the shooting-form criteria.
